subject.title: Feature Request: Token Usage API for session_status Tool

question: Should raw cumulative session, last-turn, cost, and provider-quota usage become part of `session_status`, or should OpenClaw expose it through a separate agent tool?
rationale: Both shapes are implementable, but the permanent public API, privacy boundary, freshness model, and provider-availability semantics require maintainer intent before implementation.

options.title: Extend `session_status` details
options.body: Add stable additive usage fields beside the existing rendered card while reusing current session visibility and usage aggregation.

options.title: Add a dedicated usage tool
options.body: Keep `session_status` display-oriented and expose raw usage through a separately documented, narrowly permissioned agent tool.

options.title: Keep usage outside agents
options.body: Retain transcript, Gateway, CLI, and UI usage surfaces without exposing raw usage to the agent runtime.

recommendation.title: Extend `session_status` details
recommendation.body: Add stable additive usage fields beside the existing rendered card while reusing current session visibility and usage aggregation.

likelyOwner.reason: The prior review and current-main history connect this person most directly to both the affected status/usage surfaces and the unresolved product API decision.
